subject: Agreement review + calendar mapping for contract redlines
body:
From: Alex Moreno <amoreno@greenshore.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, procurement@greenshore.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Agreement review + calendar mapping for contract redlines

Hi Tessa / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the draft and compiled a short set of redlines focused on data residency and logging. Elaine and I would like to get a focused review call with Redwood legal to go line-by-line — ideally before Thanksgiving week if possible.

Attached: Redwood_MSA_Redline_v3.docx (highlights + comments). I also exported a simple calendar mapping with our team availability (calendar-conflict-map.xlsx).

Our preferred windows (PT):
- Mon 11/22: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Tue 11/23: 09:00–11:30

Please let us know who from Redwood legal will join and any prep materials you want us to circulate.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Sr. Procurement Manager
GreenShore Health

---

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 11:02 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <amoreno@greenshore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Agreement review + calendar mapping for contract redlines

Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the calendar map. We can absolutely get legal and procurement ops aligned.

Quick notes:
- Rishi (legal) will lead the redline session and wants the doc with comments (got it).
- Marissa (CS) will take notes / action items and own the mutual action plan in HubSpot.
- Ben (deploy lead) will be on the call for any operational questions about logging/endpoints.

From our side the windows we can commit to right now (PT):
- Mon 11/22: 10:00–10:45 (tight)
- Tue 11/23: 10:30–11:30
- Wed 11/24 morning is blocked for a company town hall

If you want broader coverage, we can split into two back-to-back sessions (legal + ops) — say 45 minutes for redlines, then 30 for technical handoffs. Would that work? Also, do you prefer we pre-resolve redlines we consider non-starters (we can flag them up front)?

I’ll tentatively hold Mon 11/22 10:00 on my calendar and share a Meet link if you confirm.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 08:47 AM Alex Moreno <amoreno@greenshore.com> wrote:
From: Alex Moreno <amoreno@greenshore.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Agreement review + calendar mapping for contract redlines

Hi Tessa — apologies, travel forced a schedule shuffle on our side. Our GC just had a conflict added for Mon 11/22 at 10:00. Can we pivot to Tue 11/30 or Wed 12/1 instead?

New windows (PT) that work for our execs:
- Tue 11/30: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 12/01: 10:00–11:00

If those don't work, Elaine suggested we do a shorter legal-only triage this week (30 minutes) to prioritize top 5 redlines, then schedule the full walk-through with operations the following week.

Sorry for the churn — happy to be flexible.

Thanks,
Alex

On Tue, Nov 24, 2026 at 09:03 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <amoreno@greenshore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Agreement review + calendar mapping for contract redlines

No problem, Alex — thanks for the heads up. We can do a two-step approach which I think will be fastest to keep your launch timeline intact:

Plan A (preferred):
- 30-min legal triage this week (Thu 11/26 09:00–09:30 PT) — Rishi + Elaine + Alex to prioritize top 5 items.
- 60-min full walkthrough the week of 11/30 (Tue 11/30 09:30–10:30 PT) — Rishi + Ben + Marissa + your team.

Plan B (if Thu not possible):
- Single 90-min session Tue 11/30 09:30–11:00 PT.

Action items for you if we go Plan A:
- Confirm Thu 11/26 09:00 PT or say which 30-min slot your GC can do.
- Share any specific clauses you consider non-starters so Rishi can pre-read.

I’ll leave the calendar tentative on both ends until you confirm. If you’d like I can also open a short shared doc for top-5 triage so we don't spend time on low-impact comments on the call.

Meet link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq-def
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DW-7821

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on availability.
Tessa

Tessa — thanks, Plan A works. Elaine and I confirmed Thu 11/26 09:00 PT for the 30-min legal triage (we'll do the full session on Tue 11/30 09:30–10:30 PT).

I uploaded a short pre-read (top5_triage.md) to the HubSpot deal notes and flagged clauses 2, 4, and 7 as high priority. See the link above.

We confirmed attendees on our side: Elaine Park (GC), Alex Moreno (Procurement), and Martin Liu (Head of IT, may join for the full session).

See you Thu — I’ll let Elaine invite the short triage to the calendar.

Best,
Alex
